title: Efficient Posterior Sampling for $\mathbb Z_2$ Synchronization
summary: Consider the $\mathbb Z_2$ synchronization problem \[ \boldsymbol{Y} = \fracλ{\sqrt n} θθ^{\top} + \boldsymbol{Z}, \] where $θ$ is uniform on $\{-1,1\}^n$ and $\boldsymbol{Z}$ is an independent Gaussian Wigner matrix with off-diagonal variance one. We give a polynomial-time posterior sampling algorithm for every fixed $λ>1$, for which the conditional output law converges to the posterior in total variation, in expectation over the observation.
